info.name: Product Offering Availability And Pricing Discovery Management

The Buyer requests a list of available Product Offering Configurations from the Seller for a specific Product Specification within the specified Delivery Context. The Seller responds to the Buyer with a list of Product Configurations meeting the Buyer's criteria and the Installation Interval for each of these. Each Product Configuration has a unique identifier that is passed to the Buyer by the Seller. This identifier is used to Retrieve Pricing and Terms.

params.name: buyerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as a Buyer. MUST be specified in the request only when the requester represents more than one Buyer.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the Seller. MUST be specified in the request only when responding entity represents more than one Seller.
